verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or portability feature: no bulk export, no account-wide download, no CSV or other open-format dumps, and no offboarding path. What it does show is API, GraphQL and MCP access to customers, orders and catalog, plus cursor-paginated list endpoints. Those are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not a shipped export capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
